rec.name: Floating Video Play Button (Mobile)

what.text: A play button that opens a product or brand video. On mobile it stays visible on screen while the shopper browses. It must hide automatically when the mobile search overlay is opened, so it does not overlap the search UI or confuse shoppers looking for another product.

why.text: A video is the quickest way to show a product in use, its size and its quality, and it answers questions that photos and text leave open. A persistent, low-effort entry point raises video views without forcing the shopper to scroll. Hiding it during search removes visual clutter and avoids confusion at the moment the shopper is trying to navigate.

how.text: Add a circular play button, probably fixed or floating, that opens the video in a modal or player. Add a JS listener on the mobile search toggle (search open or close event). While search is active, hide the button with a CSS class or `display:none`. Show it again when search closes. The ticket does not say where the button is placed, what video source it uses, or how it opens.

items: Video source (URL or upload), not confirmed in ticket
Hide on mobile search active (confirmed behaviour)

dependencies.text: Not stated in the ticket. Likely a video URL or file, plus a theme hook for the mobile search open and close state.

items: Video play rate (clicks on play button per session)
Conversion rate of sessions with vs. without video play
Mobile search usage and bounce rate (to check the button does not interfere)
